outcome: Microscopic changes in the placenta and uterus
cohort: 40 women with placenta previa accreta undergoing cesarean hysterectomy at 32 to 37 weeks of gestation
finding: Microscopic examination of hysterectomy specimens from women with placenta accreta spectrum revealed thick fibrinoid deposition at the utero-placental interface, independent of villous tissue invasion depth, suggesting that accreta placentation involves more than just direct villous attachment and may be related to disruptions in the normal placental detachment process.
